tasks.label: Build Courier EXE
tasks.command: npm.cmd run dist

tasks.label: Check icon tooling
tasks.command: cmd /c "python -c \"import PIL; print(PIL.__version__)\""

tasks.label: Check SVG conversion support
tasks.command: python -c "import importlib.util; print('cairosvg', importlib.util.find_spec('cairosvg') is not None); print('PIL', importlib.util.find_spec('PIL') is not None)"

tasks.label: Install SVG icon renderer
tasks.command: cmd /c "\"C:\Users\reddy\Documents\Courier\.venv\Scripts\python.exe\" -m pip install cairosvg"

tasks.label: Generate final ICO
tasks.command:
cmd /c "\"C:\Users\reddy\Documents\Courier\.venv\Scripts\python.exe\" - <<'PY'
import cairosvg
from pathlib import Path
svg_path = Path(r'C:\Users\reddy\Documents\Courier\assets\courier-mark.svg')
out = Path(r'C:\Users\reddy\Documents\Courier\assets\courier-icon.ico')
for size in [16, 24, 32, 48, 64, 128, 256]:
    cairosvg.svg2png(url=str(svg_path), write_to=str(out.with_name(f'courier-icon-{size}.png')), output_width=size, output_height=size)
print('generated')
PY"

tasks.label: Regenerate final icon assets
tasks.command: cmd /c ""C:\Users\reddy\Documents\Courier\.venv\Scripts\python.exe" -c "import cairosvg; from pathlib import Path; svg_path = Path(r'C:\Users\reddy\Documents\Courier\assets\courier-mark.svg'); out_dir = Path(r'C:\Users\reddy\Documents\Courier\assets'); sizes = [16,24,32,48,64,128,256]; [cairosvg.svg2png(url=str(svg_path), write_to=str(out_dir / f'courier-icon-{size}.png'), output_width=size, output_height=size) for size in sizes]; print('pngs generated')" && "C:\Users\reddy\Documents\Courier\.venv\Scripts\python.exe" -c "from PIL import Image; from pathlib import Path; out_dir = Path(r'C:\Users\reddy\Documents\Courier\assets'); imgs = [Image.open(str(out_dir / f'courier-icon-{size}.png')).convert('RGBA') for size in [16,24,32,48,64,128,256]]; out = out_dir / 'courier-icon.ico'; out.write_bytes(b''); img = imgs[0]; img.save(out, format='ICO', sizes=[(i.size[0], i.size[1]) for i in imgs]); print('ico generated')"

tasks.label: Generate final app icon
tasks.command: cmd /c ""C:\Users\reddy\Documents\Courier\.venv\Scripts\python.exe" "C:\Users\reddy\Documents\Courier\scripts\generate_app_icon.py""

tasks.label: Install GTK Cairo runtime
tasks.command: cmd /c "choco install cairo -y"

tasks.label: Generate taskbar app icon

tasks.label: Rebuild Courier EXE with final icon
tasks.command: cmd /c "cd /d C:\Users\reddy\Documents\Courier && npm.cmd run dist"
